data.name: Utkarsha
data.gender_notes: Utkarsha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Utkarsha means 'progress' or 'growth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'utkarsh', which means 'to develop' or 'to progress'. This name is often given to babies who are expected to make great strides in their lives, and is a reminder that with hard work and determination, one can overcome any obstacle. The name Utkarsha carries the meaning “Progress, Growth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Utkarsha usually hope their child will grow to embody progress, growth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Utkarsha represents the spiritual journey towards self-realization and enlightenment. It is a call to continue growing and evolving, both as individuals and as part of the greater universe.
data.etymology: Utkarsha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Progress, Growth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Utkarsha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Utkarsha can be found in the Indian epic Mahabharata, where the term 'Utkarsha Prasad' is used to describe a boon granted by Lord Shiva to King Janamejaya.
